title: DaVinci Tower by Pagani — Dubai Water Canal Bespoke Penthouses
raw_content:
DaVinci Tower by Pagani

Situated directly along the Dubai Water Canal with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa, DaVinci Tower is an architectural masterpiece designed in collaboration with Horacio Pagani, founder of Pagani Automobili.

Reflecting the hypercar brand's principles of art, science, and carbon-titanium engineering, each apartment and penthouse features bespoke aerodynamic curves, custom Italian craftsmanship, and ultra-luxury materials.

Features and Specifications:

  • Exclusive collection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom residences and expansive duplex penthouses
  • Private elevators, smart home automation, and temperature-controlled wine cellars
  • Rooftop infinity pool, luxury private cinema, gym with sauna and steam rooms
  • 24/7 dedicated concierge and security
